C0464.title: Man Detained in Mao County, Sichuan for Defrauding Over 20,000 Yuan Using Fake Transfer Screenshots
C0464.summary: In February 2024, a man surnamed Yu in Mao County, Sichuan, repeatedly used delayed mobile banking transfers as a pretext and fabricated fake transaction screenshots to defraud multiple victims, involving a total amount of over 20,000 yuan. Yu has been placed under criminal detention.

references.title: Mao County man defrauds more than 20,000 yuan with fake transfer screenshots; police remind the public not to trust screenshots alone
